history.name: Changes that belong to no single feature
history.description: A change that runs across the whole product — a colour meaning, a wording pass over many screens — is recorded once against the release rather than being forced onto a dozen unrelated features. It prints once too, closing the document, instead of reading as though every area had made the same change independently.
history.dev_notes: .ledger/other-changes.json; written by `ledger other-change`, rendered as the trailing "Also since last time" block in both the Markdown and the PDF.
